name: Nevada Precision Sheet Metal
old_description: This high end precision machine is capable of cutting a broad range of materials in diameters between 5/8’s and 10’’, and up to 0.4’’ thick for mild steel. Bevel cutting up to 0.4’’ thick for mild steel.
about:
Nevada Precision Sheet Metal Inc. operates from Las Vegas, Nevada, serving the prototype and rapid-turn fabrication market. The company works from paper prints or electronic files and processes a full range of raw materials including steel, stainless steel, aluminum, copper, and spring steel in sheet, tube, angle, and channel forms.

The shop runs two flat laser cutters and one of Nevada's few CNC tube lasers, a Trumpf TruLaser Tube 7000 capable of cutting diameters from 5/8 inch to 10 inches with bevels up to 45 degrees. A 7,000 psi waterjet with a 5-axis head handles sheets up to 13 by 6 feet, while high-definition plasma machines cut aluminum, stainless, and mild steel from 3 mm to 25 mm thick. Two 14-foot CNC shears hold tolerance to ±0.005 inch, and a press brake department handles bending. Welding covers MIG and TIG for ornamental to structural work. Finishing includes a 7-by-21-foot powder-coat booth and a 40 hp sand-blasting system. In-house drafters provide 3D CAD design and modeling.

Customers span medical equipment (bed frames, carts, wheelchair frames), fitness and recreational gear (exercise machines, ATV roll cages, playground equipment), food-processing tubing, industrial furniture, construction and off-road machinery, signage and store fixtures, conveyor systems, and architectural metalwork. The company also produces components for forklifts, crane supports, and material-handling racks.

NPSM emphasizes on-time delivery and a staff of experienced fabricators dedicated to quality, positioning itself as a rapid-turn partner for prototype and short-run production.
